description: Family-wide cysteine-motif conservation and taxonomic co-occurrence: CMC4 vs COX17
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent"})

def fetch_all(query, fields, cap=3000):
    out=[]; url="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
    params={"query":query,"size":500,"fields":fields,"format":"json"}
    r=S.get(url,params=params,timeout=180)
    while True:
        out+=r.json().get("results",[])
        nxt=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if not nxt or len(out)>=cap: break
        r=S.get(nxt,timeout=180)
    return out

F="accession,organism_name,organism_id,length,sequence,lineage_ids"
cmc4set=fetch_all("xref:pfam-PF08991", F)
cox17set=fetch_all("xref:pfam-PF05051", F)
print("PF08991 (CMC4) entries:",len(cmc4set),"  PF05051 (COX17) entries:",len(cox17set))

def tab(res, lab):
    rows=[]
    for e in res:
        rows.append(dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"], org=e.get("organism",{}).get("scientificName",""),
                         taxid=e.get("organism",{}).get("taxonId"), L=e["sequence"]["length"],
                         seq=e["sequence"]["value"], fam=lab))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
A=tab(cmc4set,"CMC4"); B=tab(cox17set,"COX17")

fungal_pat=r"Saccharomyces|Candida|Kluyveromyces|Yarrowia|Aspergillus|Neurospora|Schizosaccharomyces|Ustilago|Cryptococcus|Fusarium|Penicillium|Debaryomyces|Komagataella|Zygosaccharomyces|Naumovozyma|Lachancea|Vanderwaltozyma|Torulaspora|Eremothecium|Ashbya"
print("\n=== Fungal species carrying each family in UniProtKB ===")
for df,lab in [(A,"CMC4"),(B,"COX17")]:
    f=df[df.org.str.contains(fungal_pat,case=False,na=False)]
    print(f"\n{lab}: {len(f)} fungal entries, species:")
    print(sorted(set(f.org))[:40])

print("\n--- Direct check: does Saccharomyces cerevisiae have a CMC4 (PF08991) protein? ---")
print("CMC4 S.cer hits:", A[A.org.str.contains('Saccharomyces cerevisiae',na=False)][['acc','org','L']].to_string(index=False) or "NONE")
print("COX17 S.cer hits:", B[B.org.str.contains('Saccharomyces cerevisiae',na=False)][['acc','org','L']].to_string(index=False) or "NONE")

print("\n--- Cys-motif conservation across the CMC4 family ---")
rows=[]
for r in A.itertuples():
    s=r.seq
    rows.append(dict(acc=r.acc,org=r.org,L=r.L,nCys=s.count("C"),
                     nCX9C=len(re.findall(r"(?=C.{9}C)",s)), hasCC="CC" in s,
                     nHis=s.count("H"), nMet=s.count("M")))
cd=pd.DataFrame(rows)
n=len(cd)
print(f"n = {n} CMC4-family proteins")
print(f"  >=2 strict CX9C motifs : {(cd.nCX9C>=2).sum()}/{n} = {100*(cd.nCX9C>=2).mean():.0f}%")
print(f"  adjacent CC dyad       : {cd.hasCC.sum()}/{n} = {100*cd.hasCC.mean():.0f}%")
print(f"  exactly 7 Cys          : {(cd.nCys==7).sum()}/{n} = {100*(cd.nCys==7).mean():.0f}%")
print(f"  median Cys {cd.nCys.median():.0f}, median His {cd.nHis.median():.0f}, median Met {cd.nMet.median():.0f}, median length {cd.L.median():.0f}")
print("  His-count distribution:"); print(cd.nHis.value_counts().sort_index().head(8).to_string())

rows=[]
for r in B.itertuples():
    s=r.seq
    rows.append(dict(nCys=s.count("C"), hasCCXC=bool(re.search(r"CC.C",s)), hasCC="CC" in s, nHis=s.count("H")))
bd=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(f"\nCOX17 family (n={len(bd)}): adjacent CC dyad {100*bd.hasCC.mean():.0f}%, CCxC motif {100*bd.hasCCXC.mean():.0f}%, median Cys {bd.nCys.median():.0f}")
print(f"CMC4 family: CCxC motif {100*cd.acc.isin([]).mean():.0f}% (computed below)")
ccxc=sum(bool(re.search(r"CC.C",r.seq)) for r in A.itertuples())
print(f"CMC4 family CCxC motif: {ccxc}/{n} = {100*ccxc/n:.1f}%")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4))
ax=axes[0]
ax.bar(["CMC4\n(PF08991)","COX17\n(PF05051)"],[100*cd.hasCC.mean(),100*bd.hasCC.mean()],color="#2b6cb0",width=.5,label="CC dyad")
ax.bar(["CMC4\n(PF08991)","COX17\n(PF05051)"],[100*ccxc/n,100*bd.hasCCXC.mean()],color="#c05621",width=.28,label="CCxC Cu(I) motif")
ax.set_ylabel("% of family members"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("Copper-site CCxC motif is near-universal in COX17,\nabsent from CMC4",fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
ax.hist(cd.nCys,bins=np.arange(0.5,16.5,1),color="#2b6cb0",alpha=.8,label=f"CMC4 (n={n})",density=True)
ax.hist(bd.nCys,bins=np.arange(0.5,16.5,1),color="#c05621",alpha=.6,label=f"COX17 (n={len(bd)})",density=True)
ax.axvline(7,ls="--",color="k",lw=1); ax.text(7.1,ax.get_ylim()[1]*.9,"S. pombe cmc4 = 7",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("cysteines per protein"); ax.set_ylabel("fraction of family"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("Cysteine budget per family member",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
globals()['CD']=cd; globals()['A_']=A
